svg.title: Grain: meetings, transcripts and notes through Grain's MCP server
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the Grain capability connects to Grain's hosted MCP server at api.grain.com/_/mcp with an OAuth access token, and the model sees the server's tools under the grain_ prefix. It connects when the run starts, even with defer_loading=True, so an invalid or expired token raises httpx.HTTPStatusError with status 401; return None from the auth function to give that run no Grain tools instead. read_only=True drops tools the server does not mark read-only.
